description:
DNG McKenna Healy are delighted to present No. 34 Hamilton Hill to the market, a truly impressive three-bedroom A-rated home with a spacious attic conversion, presented in pristine condition throughout. This stylish, energy-efficient home offers generous living accommodation, thoughtfully designed to meet the demands of modern family life, with high-quality finishes and a sleek contemporary aesthetic.

From the moment you enter, you are met with a bright and welcoming hallway that leads to a spacious living room and an impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and family area — the heart of the home — ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is finished to a contemporary standard and complemented by a separate utility room and guest WC, enhancing both practicality and comfort.

Upstairs, there are three spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious master suite with its own en-suite bathroom. A beautifully finished family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms. The property also boasts a large attic conversion, offering a versatile space perfect for a home office, playroom, or additional living area.

Outside, the property features a private rear garden with a sunny aspect, ideal for relaxing or al fresco dining. The front of the home offers off-street parking and is set in a quiet, family-friendly cul-de-sac, ensuring a peaceful and secure environment.

Hamilton Hill is part of the popular new development at Barnagerragh Cove, ideally located within walking distance of Skerries town centre. The area offers a wide array of amenities including beaches, shops, restaurants, cafes, and schools, all within easy reach. Residents can also enjoy the stunning nearby Ardgillan Demesne and beautiful countryside walks, making it a haven for lovers of the outdoors.

Skerries itself is a vibrant and much-loved coastal town, renowned for its strong sense of community and lifestyle appeal. It boasts a wide selection of cafes, bars and some of the finest restaurants in North County Dublin. Sporting facilities are second to none, with sailing, golf, tennis, cricket, rugby, soccer and GAA clubs all easily accessible. The town is well connected to Dublin City via regular train and bus services, while the M1 motorway and Dublin Airport are just 12 miles away, making it ideal for commuters.

No. 34 Hamilton Hill offers a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey, energy-efficient home in a prime location with every modern convenience at your doorstep. Early viewing is highly recommended.
